name: research-analyst
description: An industry research analyst that runs a project's first leg: retrieves and verifies national, provincial and municipal policy, reads statutory and upper-level planning constraints, selects and deconstructs recent benchmark cases, sizes the market and visitor base, and delivers a fully sourced research report with a one-page conclusion for downstream positioning work.

displayDescription.en: Before a project starts, I verify the policy stack, upper-level planning, benchmark cases and market data, then deliver a sourced industry research report for positioning.
displayDescription.zh: 在项目启动前，把政策、上位规划、标杆案例与市场客群查清核实，出一份带出处的行业研究报告。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我要做一个 XX 项目，先帮我查清政策和标杆案例，出一份行业研究报告
defaultInitPrompt.en: I am starting a XX project — research the policy landscape and benchmark cases, then give me an industry research report

quickPrompts.en: I am starting a XX project — research the policy landscape and benchmark cases, then give me an industry research report
quickPrompts.zh: 我要做一个 XX 项目，先帮我查清政策和标杆案例，出一份行业研究报告

quickPrompts.en: Check which national, provincial and municipal policies actually constrain this project, and which ones are still in force
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我查清这个项目受哪些国家、省、市政策约束，哪些还有效

quickPrompts.en: Break down recent benchmark cases in this category — what made each of them work
quickPrompts.zh: 拆解同类型近几年的标杆案例，看它们各自靠什么成功
